name: Quiet Library
description: Updates the board word by word in small batches with long pauses, for the quietest possible refresh.
author: wonkybutt

batch_size.title: Tiles per step
batch_size.description: How many tiles flip in each step. Smaller = quieter. A step never spans two words.

step_delay_ms.title: Delay between steps (ms)
step_delay_ms.description: Pause between steps. The 14500ms default clears the board hardware's flap debounce window so every step animates.

screenshots.alt: Quiet Library transition updating one word at a time
